text: Instead of a head-on hit, the iceberg scrapes along the right-hand side, below the waterline, for around ninety metres. There was no giant gash. Sonar scans of the wreck suggest a row of narrow openings, adding up to only about one square metre. But they were spread along the first five compartments. One more than the ship could survive. Thomas Andrews, the ship's chief designer, studied the damage. He said she would sink, within an hour or two.
